listing.name: Building Menu Overhaul
listing.summary: In very short term : Overhaul for building menu that introduces searchbar, tag filters and a lof of useful stuff
listing.aiSummary: Overhauls the building menu by adding a search bar, tag filters, and an upgrade queue.

description: Replaces the standard building interface with one featuring search functionality and category tags. It includes an integrated indicator for which industry is being used and allows queuing of upgrades. The update also improves UI performance and fixes bugs related to construction queues and tooltips.
